2.204.8
StateIndicator.ParentItem
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The StateIndicator.ParentItem element specifies the name of the StateIndicator parent element.
The StateIndicator.ParentItem element is ignored if it is present in any schema version prior to
RDL 2010/01. However, its data type is validated, and the value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2]
section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String. The StateIndicator.ParentItem element
is optional.
The following is the parent element of the StateIndicator.ParentItem element.
Parent elements
StateIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the StateIndicator.ParentItem element.
 <xsd:element name="ParentItem" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
